metadata.description: jevmem: automatic project memory for Cursor. One plugin: hooks that save each finished agent turn, an MCP server that brings memory back, and the rule that tells the agent to ask for it.

plugins.name: jevmem
plugins.description: jevmem keeps your project's decisions, rules and failed approaches in JEVMEM.md in your repo, shared with your team through git, and gives them to the agent when it asks. Saves each finished agent turn on its own. Needs the jevmem CLI from npm and a paid TypeSafe API key. Opt-in per project: elsewhere it saves and sends nothing.
